services.name: ATV & Off-Road
services.desc: Tumbler Ridge is the premier destination for off-road vehicle enthusiasts seeking an unparalleled ATV riding experience. Our vast network of marked and unmarked trails spans hundreds of kilometres, providing riders of all skill levels with an array of exciting options. Discover cut lines, power lines, pipelines, forestry roads, and mountaintop trails offering breathtaking views that are sure to leave you in awe. Come explore the unforgettable ATV riding opportunities waiting for you in Tumbler Ridge. services.name: Disc Golf
services.desc: Tumbler Ridge continues to expand its outdoor recreation offerings with the addition of a permanent disc golf course, established by the Wolverine Nordic and Mountain Society in partnership with the District of Tumbler Ridge and with support from the Northern Development Initiative Trust. Integrated into Tumbler Ridge’s expanding outdoor recreation network, the Wolverine Disc Golf Course offers a welcoming, accessible experience for visitors and residents alike. Disc golf, one of the fastest-growing outdoor sports in the world, combines light physical activity, strategy, and time spent in nature. blurb: Located in a beautiful creek setting, this campground has 40 sites and is located just 1 km from town. Amenities include; fire pits, firewood, a cooking shelter, picnic areas, playground, hiking trails and swimming hole. Also on site: a sani-station, flush toilets and hot showers. No hook-ups, pets welcome. Open from May to October. Online booking is now available.
